# Growth Buddies

> Growth Buddies SpA is a Chilean company that builds and implements operational tools with AI. It leads with packaged products for expense reporting, document management and customer assistants, and includes implementation, training and adoption.

Last updated: 2026-11-01. Website: https://growthbuddies.cl

## Products

- [Expense Buddy](https://growthbuddies.cl/expense-buddy): expense reporting for companies with field teams. Offline capture with sync when the app is opened with connection, installable web app, AI receipt extraction, approval in up to two levels (manager then finance) with delegation and auto-approval, budgets and balances, multi-currency with a reference exchange rate, white-label branding, dedicated environment per client, CSV, XLSX and ZIP exports, admin dashboards. One-time implementation from 45 UF + VAT, including a perpetual license. Optional maintenance from 4 UF per month with all product improvements. Open demo without sign-up: https://expense-buddy-demo.web.app
- [DocFlow Buddy](https://growthbuddies.cl/docflow-buddy): document and case management with AI for law firms and companies that manage documents for their clients. Case intake, requirements per case type, AI document review, stage tracking with a control view, client portal, email notifications. From 60 UF + VAT.
- [Agent Buddy Web](https://growthbuddies.cl/agent-buddy): AI assistant on the client's website, trained on their real processes. Fixed package, live in under a month, 30 days of implementation plus 60 days of support. From 20 UF + VAT.
- [Agent Buddy a medida](https://growthbuddies.cl/agent-buddy): agents connected to the client's processes and systems, multichannel, with human handoff. From 50 UF + VAT.
- [Proyecto a medida](https://growthbuddies.cl/proyecto-a-medida): for problems no product covers. Paid diagnostic of CLP 490,000 + VAT in 10 to 15 days, with a working mockup, 100% creditable to a project contracted within 90 days.

## What the products do not include

Expense Buddy does not validate documents with Chile's tax authority (SII), does not integrate with ERPs, does not capture expenses through WhatsApp, and does not offer electronic signature or a full advance-request workflow.

## Facts

- Market: Chile first. Also operates in Colombia, Peru and Ecuador.
- Track record: more than 40 organizations, more than 20 AI projects, more than 500 people trained.
- Results: an intellectual property firm with presence in 4 countries grew revenue 17% in 3 to 4 months. Ingeglobal, a mining engineering consultancy, turned a real-time measurement system with alerts into a new monetizable product.
- Google rating: 5.0 on its Business Profile.
- Method: implementation, training and adoption. Value comes when people actually use the tool.
- Founder: Edmundo Spohr, 15+ years of experience, ex Microsoft (via JLL) and Bechtel, with Prosci and Scrum certifications. https://growthbuddies.cl/equipo/edmundo-spohr
- Co-founder: Felipe Soto Santibáñez. https://growthbuddies.cl/equipo/felipe-soto-santibanez
